div.head: Ordal 2
div.ab: 7 gif hit anfeald tyhle sy, dúfe seo hand ǽfter þam stane oð þa wríste, 7 gif hit þryfeald sy, oð þæne élbogan.
Et si anfeald tihla sit, inmergatur manus post lapidem (ut examen) usque ad ƿriste, et si triplex accusatio sit, usque ad cubitum.
And gif hit anfeald tyhle sy, dúfe seo hand ǽfter þam stane oð þa wríste, and gif hit þryfeald sy, oð þæne élbogan.
Und wenn es einfache Klage ist, tauche die Hand nach dem Steine [im siedenden Kessel] bis zur Handwurzel, und wenn es dreifache ist, bis zum Ellbogen.
And if it is a single accusation, let the hand dive after the stone [in the boiling cauldron] up to the wrist, and if it is threefold, up to the elbow.
And if the accusation is 'single', the hand shall be plunged in up to the wrist in order to reach the stone; if it is 'threefold', up to the elbow.
div.note: Thorpe alters ‘tyhle’ to ‘tyhtle’; but compare the Quadripartitus and I Cn 5–5.2 MS A.
